# Swiftcode

> Swiftcode is a software company in Athurugiriya, Sri Lanka, building ERP software, POS systems, custom web applications, and iOS/Android mobile apps for growing businesses since 2022.

## Pages

- [Home](https://swiftcode.lk/): ERP, POS, web and mobile software development in Sri Lanka.
- [Services & Projects](https://swiftcode.lk/services): ERP software development, POS systems for retail and restaurants, custom web applications, mobile app development, plus FAQs.
- [About Us](https://swiftcode.lk/about): Company values, milestones, and team.
- [Contact](https://swiftcode.lk/contact): Request a free software quote. Phone +94 70 490 0850, +94 76 621 6791. Email swiftcode.srilanka@gmail.com.

## Services

- ERP software: finance, HR, inventory, multi-branch operations, real-time analytics.
- POS systems: touch-optimized, multi-payment support, inventory sync, loyalty programs, offline mode.
- Web applications: full-stack development, REST/GraphQL APIs, cloud deployment.
- Mobile applications: native iOS & Android, push notifications, offline-first, app store submission.
